resources.string: To add a widget, open the widget picker and locate the ToggleBay widget.
Can control ToggleBay plugins and receive their state updates.

ToggleBay has no account, ads SDK, analytics SDK, or app-operated remote data collection. Android device backup may copy eligible app settings to the user’s Google backup when device backup is enabled.

ToggleBay is an independent modern Android utility derived from the MIT-licensed Power Toggles codebase by Sunny Goyal and contributors. It is not the original Power Toggles app and is not presented as an official continuation.
